newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Ortiz sees Q2 GDP up between 5.5-5.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Ortiz sees Q2 GDP up between 5.5-5.6 pct.

text.p: Mexico's Finance Minister Guillermo Ortiz on Friday said he expected economic growth in the second quarter of around 5.5 or 5.6 percent.
"We're expecting growth in the second quarter of around 5.5, 5.6 percent," Ortiz said during a speech to a business forum in this Caribbean resort.
First quarter growth was 5.1 percent, and a Reuters survey of economists' forecasts on average a second quarter rise in gross domestic product of 5.19 percent.
Ortiz attributed the growth to dynamic industrial sector activity, especially in manufacturing. He said industrial activity "is much higher than pre-crisis levels."
The finance ministry said earlier this week that industrial activity grew 15 percent in April compared with the same month in 1996.
